location.name: Nyeri area, central Kenya (East of the Rift Valley)

source: S03 Gichuru et al. 2021, Agronomy 11(12):2590 (spray timing, rust peaks)
S33 NASA POWER daily PRECTOTCORR 1991 to 2020 (modelled rainfall, onset median 16 Oct and 20 Mar)
note: Decision windows for rules.json, derived from kb/research/season.json. One window per date, first match wins, windows cover the whole year. Edges are plus or minus two weeks; S03 says the spray programme must be adjusted to the weather. 'dry' covers both drier spells, which include the rust peaks after each rainy season (S03).

windows.name: pre_short_rains
windows.basis: S03: sprays start mid-October just before the short rains, second spray three weeks later; NASA POWER median onset 16 Oct

windows.name: dry
windows.basis: NASA POWER driest spell; S03 rust peak January to March

windows.name: pre_long_rains
windows.basis: S03: first spray late February or early March, repeat at three weeks; NASA POWER median onset 20 Mar

windows.name: dry
windows.basis: NASA POWER drier mid-year; S03 rust peak May to June
